reasons.text: 98% of feedstock comes from collectors invoicing far beyond their declared capacity
75% of purchase invoices have suspiciously round tonnages (typical plant: about 2%)
Electricity bought is only 0.44x the minimum needed for the tonnes claimed (9 kWh/t against at least 20)
71% of high-value consignments have no e-way bill
In 100% of billed months the units consumed cannot support the tonnes claimed
98% of feedstock comes from collectors registered under 6 months before their first invoice

inspection_checklist: Visit the named collectors: confirm premises, vehicles and storage; check their registration dates and sales to other buyers.
Physically verify a sample of purchase invoices with the sellers (weighbridge slips, e-way bills, vehicle logs).
Obtain the DISCOM consumption statement and meter readings for the flagged months; compare connected machinery (kW) against the claimed tonnage.
